mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when rates remain below 4.0%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in past 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in past 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, manufacturing sector weakness signals potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above 360,000 million dollars signals strong economic activity, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 thousand units signals a robust housing market, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 2100.

mechanism_narrative: A declining labor force participation (measured by PAYEMS growth rate) below 0.2% per month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate < 0.2% per month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates strong manufacturing activity, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110.0.
